question: After `imsg` 0.13.1 is published and packaged live proof passes, should OpenClaw make it a hard iMessage startup floor and retire `coalesceSameSenderDms`?
rationale: The change intentionally converts older binaries and stale persisted config into operator-action upgrade states; tests establish mechanics but cannot accept the release and compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve after packaged proof
options.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after released v0.13.1 passes the exact-head doctor and split-send scenario.

options.title: Defer the teardown
options.body: Retain the current config and client-side fallback until maintainers choose a later dependency transition.

recommendation.title: Approve after packaged proof
recommendation.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after released v0.13.1 passes the exact-head doctor and split-send scenario.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily concerns the supported `imsg` release floor and publication and upgrade policy.
